Body.Content:
The Azure Content Delivery Network (CDN) is a service that allows you to send audio, images, and other static files faster and more reliably to customers across the globe. With a CDN, enterprises can save on compute costs while increasing site performance for their end users. This is especially critical for media-heavy corporate presence and marketing campaign sites. With the new CDN integration, users can now seamlessly integrate their site content with the Azure CDN using the Azure Management Portal.

Learn More

Learn more about CDN Integration with Websites.
